column1: # Game profile of Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter (Switch, update 1.0.4 = v393216). Plays on the Mac (the title, a new game on Normal, the prologue's cutscenes in Grancel Castle, walking
# in its garden terrace, the save menu, at 60 fps)
# Nihon Falcom's engine (the Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter remake's), SDK 21.4.4, the SDK's movie player (subsdk0). Its shaders are GLSLC compiler outputs: 11,322 in asset/nx/shader/*.nvn
# and 18 in main. The provisional profile's guesses held: no key needed changing

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory), and main sets a heap: 2.02 GB asked (the NSP script's heap check), a 2.125 GB heap region in a 5 GB block.
# The alias region below is the iPhone layout. At boot the engine's allocator takes an 11.27 GB address region (ten times its 0x48200000-byte capacity, returning to main+0x6a1dcc)
# and maps 0.40 GB of it; on the Mac the alias region is 64 GB and holds it. An iPhone has no room for it: not run there yet (the game's note, Open)
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
